internal.title: Incident Review: Cart Service High Error Rate Due to Dependency Unreachable
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 11:29 UTC, the cart service triggered a high error rate alert. Diagnosis identified a dependency unreachable fault related to the Valkey service, causing the cart service errors. The issue was mitigated by disabling the cartFailure flag at 11:49 UTC, which restored normal service error rates. Recovery was verified shortly after the mitigation action. Other services such as checkout and frontend showed elevated error rates but were not confirmed as root causes.

Timeline:
- 11:29:18 Alert received for cart service error rate spike
- 11:49:01 Diagnosis confirmed dependency unreachable in cart
- 11:49:06 Mitigation action executed (flag disabled)
- 11:49:06 Recovery verified with normalized error rates

Next steps include reviewing dependency monitoring and improving alert escalation procedures.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Errors Resolved
external.body: Between 11:29 and 11:49 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced errors when using the cart service due to a temporary issue with a dependent service. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are working to prevent similar issues in the future.
